ui.about.title: Fa Watchcoin (WTC) ho
ui.about.p1: Watchcoin yɛ app a woyɛ nnwuma na wunya akyɛdeɛ. Woyɛ nnwuma tiatia a ɛyɛ mmerɛ, sɛ video hwɛ, pɛ, akyi di anaa abatoɔ ano yi, na wunya WTC token wɔ biara ho.
ui.about.h1: Nnwuma foforo 5 da biara bere biara, na biara wɔ n'akyɛdeɛ
ui.about.h2: Da biara nkɔsoɔ akyɛdeɛ, ne ntwahonan dan bere a wowie da no nnwuma nyinaa
ui.about.h4: WTC 50 wɔ adamfo biara a wofrɛɛ no na ɔwie adwuma ho
ui.about.h5: Premium nhyehyɛe ma wo nnwuma pii da biara
ui.about.launchP: {launch}. Kɔsi saa bere no, wo WTC sika wɔ app no mu dwoodwoo. Wobɛtumi de WTC amane na woasesa no wɔ mfiaseɛ akyi, na yɛbɛka ho nsɛm wɔ app no mu ansa.
ui.about.usdtP: USDT dodoɔ a wuhu no yɛ nsusuiɛ. Ɛde app no ankasa bo na ɛyɛ (1 WTC = {p} USDT) na ɛnyɛ gua so bo biara. Mfiaseɛ akyi no, WTC bo ankasa wɔ gua so bɛtumi akɔ soro, aba fam, anaa ɛrenni bo biara.
ui.about.readP: Obiara ntumi nhyɛ bɔ sɛ WTC bɛsom sika, anaa sɛ obi bɛnya mfasoɔ sɛ ɔkura mu a. Nya WTC ma anigyeɛ anaa sɛ ntoasoɔ. Tua Premium nhyehyɛe ho ka sɛ ɛmma wo werɛ nhow sɛ wobɛhwere sika no nko ara, na nnfa bosea biara mmɛka ho.
ui.about.fairP: Akontaabu baako ma onipa biara. Bot, akontaabu atorɔ ne nnaadaa ma wɔsiw wo kwan na wohwere wo token. Wowɔ asɛmmisa anaa ɔhaw? Fa fi Me tab no so soma.
